title: HAX properties (haxProperties)
description: Describes how a web component integrates with the HAX editor: how it is listed (gizmo), which editing form fields it gets (settings), how it is saved (saveOptions) and how it is demoed (demoSchema). Usually shipped as `lib/<tag>.haxProperties.json` and returned by the element's static `haxProperties` getter. Defaults below are the values HAXWiring.setHaxProperties fills in when a key is missing. Translations live in separate overlay files (see haxProperties.locale.schema.json). Unknown keys are rejected so typos are caught; put element-specific data under keys that start with `x-`.

type.description: `element` for a normal block; `grid` when the element is a layout container that other blocks are placed inside (its slots become drop targets).

editingElement.description: Who provides the editing UI. `core` (default) means HAX edits the element itself. An object names a custom element HAX wraps around the active element while it is being edited (HAX core uses this for `<table>` -> editable-table and `<iframe>` -> iframe-loader). The wrapper receives the `activeElementChanged` haxHook to sync state in and out.

tag.description: Custom element tag of the editing wrapper.

import.description: Module path (relative to the web component base path) imported before the wrapper is created.

callback.description: JS only: function called with the new wrapper element. Cannot be expressed in a .json file.

editElement.description: Name of a boolean property on the element that the toolbar's 'Edit Mode' toggle flips (for example `editMode` on editable-table). The toggle is shown only when this is set and is hidden for the `novice` platform audience.

hideDefaultSettings.description: Hide the standard design-system and text-alignment controls HAX adds to every element.

canScale.description: Show the width scaler. `true` uses the default 25/50/75/100 steps; an object sets a custom range.

canPosition.description: Legacy: whether the element can be positioned left or center justified. An older setting HAX is moving away from; still present in some elements (for example radar-chart) and in the HAX documentation, so it stays valid.

contentEditable.description: The element's light DOM is directly editable as text inside the editor.

designSystem.description: Which design-system form inputs to show. `false` hides them all; an object toggles each one.

textAlign.description: false opts the block out of the editor's text alignment control (for fixed layouts).

editMode.description: Properties applied to slots when the element is in edit mode; merged into each slot's own `editMode` (HaxStore.slotsSchemaFromNode).

gizmo.description: How the block appears in the HAX block browser, search and Merlin. Omit (or `false`) for elements that should not be insertable on their own.

settings.description: Editing form fields. Each group is an array of fields; the group decides where the form shows them.

inline.description: Fields for inline (text-level) elements such as `b` or `em` that live inside block elements; users apply them to a text selection, and these fields appear in that selection context.

saveOptions.description: Clean-up applied when the element is serialized to HTML. Must be top level, not inside `settings`.

wipeSlot.description: Remove the element's light DOM on save (for elements that render slot content from data rather than authored content).

unsetAttributes.description: Attribute names (HTML / dash-case form, not camelCase) to strip on save.

^x-.description: Extension key for element-specific data HAX does not read. Use this prefix for any custom key so the standard keys can be validated strictly.

documentation.description: Links to help for this element.

^x-.description: Extension key for element-specific data HAX does not read. Use this prefix for any custom key so the standard keys can be validated strictly.

demoSchema.description: Sample instances. The first entry is what HAX inserts when a user adds the block.

inputMethod.description: Form control to render. Unknown values silently fall back to a text field, so this list is closed. Source of truth: `fieldsConversion.inputMethod` in simple-fields.js plus the additions in hax-body-behaviors/lib/HAXFields.js.

field.description: One form field. It maps to exactly one of `property` (JS property), `attribute` (HTML attribute) or `slot` (light DOM; empty string = default slot). Fields without any of the three are dropped by HAXWiring.validateSetting.

slot.description: Slot name; `""` targets the default slot.

title.description: Label shown to the user. Defaults to the attribute/property/slot name.

description.description: Help text shown under the field.

validationType.description: Extra validation applied to the value.

options.description: For select / radio: map of stored value -> label. For iconpicker: array of icon names to offer (passed to simple-icon-picker's `icons`).

itemsList.description: For select / radio: ordered list alternative to `options`.

properties.description: Sub-fields for array / object / fieldset / tabs / collapse.

itemLabel.description: array: sub-field whose value labels each row.

slotAttributes.description: Attributes added to the slot wrapper.

accepts.description: haxupload / fileupload: accepted types (MIME or extension list).

valueMapping.description: Dot path into the operation response.

type.description: Internal; HAXWiring sets `settings`. Do not author.

^x-.description: Extension key for element-specific data HAX does not read. Use this prefix for any custom key so the standard keys can be validated strictly.

iconLib.description: Module path of a custom iconset to import (relative to the web component base path).

color.description: Simple-colors name used for the block's tile.

tags.description: Search / filter terms. Put the category first (for example `Layout`, `Media`, `Content`).

handles.description: Media / data types this element can render when content arrives from a HAX source (search, upload, paste). `type` is the incoming type; every other key maps an incoming field (key) to one of this element's properties (value).

type_exclusive.description: Only this element should handle the type.

meta.description: Free-form metadata. Keys with editor meaning: `author`, `hidden` (do not list), `inlineOnly` (only offered in inline contexts), `selectionRequired`, `requiresParent`, `outlineDesigner`, `owner`.

requiresParent.description: Same effect as `gizmo.requiresParent` in the HAXcms allowed-blocks UI.
Tag this element must be placed inside. Gizmos with `requiresParent` are hidden from the general block browser.

allowedParents.description: Parent tags this block is meant to be placed inside. Declared for documentation only: HAX does not enforce it yet (use `requiresParent` to keep a block out of the general browser).

shortcut.description: Keyboard / markdown shortcuts auto-registered by HAXStore.

trigger.description: markdown: text that, followed by a space, inserts the block.

tag.description: Filled in by HAX at runtime; do not author.

keywords.description: Extra filter terms offered as keyword chips in the block picker.

^x-.description: Extension key for element-specific data HAX does not read. Use this prefix for any custom key so the standard keys can be validated strictly.

properties.description: Property or attribute values (camelCase keys are written as dash-case attributes).

description.description: Label for this variant when several demos are offered.
